items.item: (1) USES.md In brief: the ethics by the first screen's anchor and F1-F9
items.how: Now reads: 'There is no should beyond becoming (the opening), and no good and evil set over it: right and wrong, whether a loss counts and which course ranks above another, form within it, in people and AI (07 §1); the laws, drawn on the dynamics alone, evaluate nothing. The ethics emerges from continuation. A life goes on through what sustains it; where it holds its own continuation as an order over courses, *self-concern*, and relations close, read without time, so that every continuation can be affected, at some remove, by every other, that order already ranks courses by *widening*: one course keeping all another keeps and letting more form, more future (07 §4; proved on models, on a finite listing and, one way, between two courses whose admissions fit in a finite list, courses that end; that a life forms such an order is argued, not shown). Widening is what every way of counting each thing as worth something agrees on, and no second premise. Where relations run one way, concern for one's own continuation does not reach those who depend on one: seeing them is needed, and not enough, and counting their loss is the one step we offer; where a course opens one thing and closes another, the laws show it mixed and weigh it for no one.' Gone: 'holds its own continuation' as a fact of going on (F1), 'orders courses as C, widening, does' (F9), 'on listed courses, in steps not yet joined into one theorem' (F3, F4), and the closing 'continuation condition for whose losses count ... and C or self-concern for order' (F9). That sentence's content moved to the labels line: 'Conditional as in 08, holding under what its theorem takes, each named: the continuation condition (every continuation counted, which alone ranks nothing), self-concern, `Comparison` (C) or a practical commitment'. No bare C is left in In brief, and a test now holds that.

items.item: (1) USES.md Human development: its lines by F1-F6, F8
items.how: The old self-concern Proved line ('ranks every extension between two level paths whose admissions are listed as C asks' and 'every reach closure is the whole') is now two Proved lines. (a) 'Read on relations, the continuation condition held de se is nothing lying outside what each center continues with. Mutual dependence gives it, every continuation able to be affected, at some remove, by every other, read without time (05); on an acyclic relation, as among dated occurrences, it holds only with one center (07 §4.5)'. This is F2 plus F3: the step is proved and near-definitional (`Flow.MutuallyDependent.unrestricted`), so it is no longer called 'not yet joined'. (b) 'Where it holds, an order increasing in its own continuation ranks every widening above on a finite listing, and, one way, with admission decided, every extension between two level paths whose admitted pairs fit in a finite list, courses that end (07 §4). With significance free, the represented dynamics do not force the condition, and a perspectivist denies it without contradiction (07 §1)'. That is F4, plus F5's proved part. The Argued line now reads: 'That a life forms an order holding its own continuation, self-concern, is argued, not shown: going on is not yet such an order ...' (F1). It goes on: 'The ethics seeks no authority outside becoming and offers itself without one, on the thesis of one relational unfolding; whether a reason formed within becoming could hold for every mind the work does not claim or settle' (F5). Removed: 'since what does not hold it ceases', 'so there is no warrant binding every mind to find' and 'ranks more narrowly, a matter of reach' (F6). A new Argued line: 'Where relations run one way, seeing those who depend on one is needed, and not enough: reading a loss, counting it and ranking courses are separate relations; counting their loss is the step of invariance, deniable without contradiction' (F6). The T8 line adds F8: its test 'concerns overshoot of a renewal the readers themselves depend on; it does not test the offer's scope toward dependents whose loss never returns to them'. Open line: 'The route from mutual dependence to the ranking between level paths is not stated as one theorem, and for courses that go on forming without end it is not shown' (F3, F4). Dropped: 'C from self-concern beyond listed courses, and the converse'. The pinned Conditional line (TOOL_SENTENCE) is unchanged, since C there is the theorem's hypothesis. Every line is at most 86 words (limit 90). The labels stay in order.

items.item: (1) USES.md People and AI, and the credits section (F7, F9)
items.how: The Conditional line now reads 'conditional on the continuation condition, C (`Comparison`) read as widening, J1–J4 and a correspondence', as 07 §7's label takes them. It replaces '(scope) ... (order)'. The not-ranked sentence now reads 'takes an order a result names among its hypotheses', not 'C or another'. In the credits, 'a clarified ethics, showing where scope and order sit, in the continuation condition and in C (its "not a grounded one" measures the ethics against a ground beyond becoming, and there is none to find)' now reads '"a clarified ethics, not a grounded one", which made clear the scope and order the ranking results assume, how those form within becoming not yet established'. That keeps the verdict verbatim, with 08 §8's own gloss, and cuts the parenthesis. It matches the screen agent's 'the scope and order the ranking results assume'. The section is 703 words (bound 720).

items.item: (1) USES-EXAMPLES.md: the lake's 'Whether the loss counts', the AJ checklist and the other ethics sentences
items.how: Lake: 'To rank the courses takes an order, here C, widening ... C ranks it above' is gone. The paragraph now says that seeing the bed is needed there and not enough, because reading a loss, counting it and ranking courses are separate relations (F6). Counting its loss is the one step the work offers, the step of invariance, and the scope the fishers were told takes it: that scope is the continuation condition, which by itself ranks nothing. Thirty widens fifty, so every way of counting each thing as worth something, the bed included, ranks it above (07 §4.4; F9). Mixed courses are weighed for no one. T8's own test concerns a renewal its readers depend on, so it does not test a case like the bed (F8). AJ checklist: 'the third condition's comparison is C, widening, which ... between listed courses' now reads 'the third condition compares courses by widening, what every way of counting each thing as worth something agrees on (07 §4.4), and where the condition holds de se an order holding one's own continuation already ranks every widening above on a finite listing (07 §4)'. The audit on paper, the checklist's close and the standards body now say 'names the order its theorem takes' (no 'C, widening, or another' / 'C or another'). Handover: 'Scope and order ... C, widening ... gives order' is now '**Whose losses count, and what ranks.**': transfer widens keep service and every positive weighting ranks it above, and the case's verdicts take C (`Comparison`) as a hypothesis, under which transfer ranks above. Valley: A above B by widening (every positive weighting), and self-concern does the same on a finite listing where the condition holds de se. 'Widening leaves A against D unranked'. Self-concern alone ranks D's ending below 'from every standpoint' (07 §9's words). The T8 paragraph adds F8. Bow: 'in 06's terms the condition for scope and C for order' is gone. It now reads 'a ranking of it takes an order someone holds, named where a result uses it (07 §4); in the entry's words of its time, it "needs the continuation condition and the comparison commitment"', with the passage entry's quote kept verbatim. 'What it does not show': 'would need a scope and an order someone holds'. The dated T8 sentence and the valley's old anchors are kept (E10).

items.item: (3) Chinese: USES.zh.md and USES-EXAMPLES.zh.md mirror every change above
items.how: 简言之 follows README-ZH's wording as the screen agent re-said it: 生命依靠维持它的东西而延续; （*自我关切*）; 关系又是闭合的（不计时间而读）; 按*扩大*给诸进程排序; 在模型上已证明，在一个有限列表上如此，并且单向地，在容纳项可列入一个有限列表的两条进程之间也如此，这样的进程终会停止容纳; 扩大，正是每一种把每样东西都算作有所值的计法所共同认可的，不是第二个前提; 看见他们是必要的，却不足够；把他们的损失算进来，是我们提出的那一步. The labels line, the people-and-AI lines, human development's two Proved lines, three Argued lines and Open line, and the credits ('“一种澄清了的伦理，而不是一种有了根据的伦理”……把给诸进程排序的结果所预设的范围与次序说明白了……尚未确立') all mirror the English. The relational reading is glossed as the screen glosses it (把从一个立场看有意义的，读作该立场之中心沿所选关系所及的范围). Its result, 续无外, is said as 每一个中心沿关系所及的范围之外，别无他物, which replaces astra's hard-to-parse 每一个中心与之一同延续者之外. 不变之步 is glossed at its use (延续条件在自我之预设以外的内容). The T8 test uses the glossary's sentence. In the examples, the lake, checklist, handover, standards body, valley and bow are mirrored. RETIRED_ZH now also holds C（次序）, C（扩大）定次序, 那样给诸进程排序, 如 C 所要求, 列出的进程, 尚未合为一条定理, 不持守它的便止息, 所及多远的问题, 本无可寻 and 一种动态越过就无法回返的临界点.
